info.title: fitcheck-nutritionlibrary-service API
info.description: Manages each user's private macro targets, personal food library, and reusable preset meal templates with auto-calculated nutrition totals.

post.description:
This operation requires session parameters: userId (ID, required).
To access the route, the session should have roles: **[superAdmin]**.

201.description: Response JSON represents the most comprehensive form of the **macroTarget** object in the response. However, some properties may be omitted based on the object's internal logic.
